memory_shards.rule: KEEPER records (Act IV) show every pioneer finds the same 40 shards in the same places. Shard triggers are identical in every region. In donor_real shards, P1's voice is the player's chosen voice: the player's own voice telling Rowan's real life.

shards.title: Bedtime

trigger.where: inside the tipped lander, first wake

transcript.speaker: ALICE
transcript.text: Will you see the stars better from Mars?

transcript.speaker: DAD
transcript.text: Every night. I'll look straight at Ireland.

shards.truth: Construct. Every pioneer wakes to this one.

shards.title: The Kitchen

transcript.speaker: LUCY
transcript.text: You've packed the rock hammer twice.

transcript.speaker: LUCY
transcript.text: One for Mars. Leave the other for me, so I've something to throw at you.

shards.truth: Construct. The kitchen is assembled from a real Galway flat Rowan rented alone.

shards.title: Galway, 2021
shards.truth: Real. Rowan was three when Perseverance landed; his mother held him up to the laptop.

shards.title: A Real Lake

transcript.speaker: DAD
transcript.text: Right where I'll be standing. Fifty metres deep.

shards.truth: Construct.

shards.title: The Pier

transcript.speaker: LUCY
transcript.text: Yes. God. Yes. Get up, you're kneeling in a puddle.

shards.truth: Mixed. The pier at Salthill and Lucy are real: they were together through his early thirties. The proposal never happened. MEM.33 is the real version, same place.

shards.title: Ring Me

transcript.speaker: ALICE
transcript.text: Can you ring me from Mars?

transcript.speaker: DAD
transcript.text: Not for a while. But I'll be thinking it, every night.

shards.truth: Construct; written to make Silent Protocol bearable.

shards.title: Corridor
shards.truth: Construct. A hospital corridor that exists in no hospital.

shards.title: That's You

trigger.condition: first time in the rover (after C04)

transcript.speaker: ALICE
transcript.text: That's you. That's the rocket. That's me, waving.

shards.truth: Construct; paired with Alice's Drawing 1 behind the dash glass.

shards.title: Kick the Wall

trigger.where: north rim, start of the water road

transcript.speaker: MAM
transcript.text: Kick the wall, Rowan. Everyone kicks the wall.

shards.truth: Real. Salthill promenade; the Galway custom of kicking the wall at the end of the prom.

shards.title: Big Spoon

transcript.speaker: DAD
transcript.text: Frozen, under the dirt. I'm going to dig it up.

shards.truth: Construct.

shards.title: Steady

transcript.speaker: LUCY
transcript.text: Hold the line. No. Steady. The sea knows when you're nervous.

shards.truth: Construct, built on the real Lucy's job (marine biologist).

shards.title: Layers

transcript.speaker: LUCY
transcript.text: Every layer's a year the world wrote down.

shards.truth: Construct. LODESTONE has just told him it isn't true. The construct is wrong about geology; Rowan never was.

shards.title: Wish
shards.truth: Construct; guilt as fuel.

shards.title: Field of Stones

transcript.speaker: MAM
transcript.text: Your granny grew potatoes in a field of stones in Connemara. Stubbornness. That's all it takes.

shards.truth: Real.

shards.title: Next Year
shards.truth: Construct; a launch video on a tablet.

shards.title: Window

transcript.speaker: ALICE
transcript.text: Will my room have a window?

transcript.speaker: DAD
transcript.text: The biggest window. You'll see the whole crater.

shards.truth: Construct.

shards.title: Eat Properly
shards.truth: Construct.

shards.title: Dust Devil

transcript.speaker: DAD
transcript.text: You'll be sick. Stop spinning. Stop... fine, one more.

shards.truth: Construct.

shards.title: Week One

transcript.speaker: DES
transcript.text: You're the Galway lad that's read the whole reading list. Wise up, it's week one.

shards.truth: Real. University of Belfast, Geography, 2036. Des's voice is ANVIL's without the grille: an attentive player can hear it.

shards.title: Causeway

transcript.speaker: DES
transcript.text: Forty thousand columns and you're looking at one.

transcript.speaker: DES
transcript.text: Bet you a pint I get to Mars before you.

shards.truth: Real. The Giant's Causeway field trip and the running joke.

shards.title: Is It Cold

transcript.speaker: ALICE
transcript.note: the C01 take, with a different reverb: the shard is a repeat

shards.truth: Construct, repeated: the system recycling a motivational anchor.

shards.title: Are You Eating
shards.truth: Real. Galway, 2055, a flat full of rock samples.

shards.title: Drink Your Water

transcript.speaker: LUCY
transcript.text: Drink your water. You never drink enough water.

shards.truth: Construct. Water is coolant.

shards.title: Doctor Ashby

transcript.speaker: DES
transcript.text: Look at you. Doctor Ashby. Come to see how the other half lives.

transcript.speaker: DES
transcript.text: It will be. You'll be insufferable.

shards.truth: Real. The Belfast shipyard, 2041: the only time Rowan visited.

shards.title: Fear
shards.truth: Construct.

shards.title: Selection
shards.truth: Real. 2056, the ESI letter.

shards.title: Swapped

transcript.speaker: ALICE
transcript.text: ...the red road rising, the cities to be.
transcript.note: Alice says P1's lines, as if the roles were swapped; wrong reverb

shards.truth: Construct, corrupted.

shards.title: Dear Cara

transcript.speaker: P1_MEM
transcript.text: Dear Cara. Olympus Mons is taller than Slieve Donard. About twenty-one times taller. When I get to Mars I'll send you a picture. Love, Uncle Rowan.
transcript.note: reading his own letter aloud as he writes it

shards.truth: Real. 2054. The name means nothing yet. Pays off in C17, and in Fugitive mode on Olympus.

shards.title: Voicemail

transcript.speaker: DES
transcript.text: Ro, it's Des. Give us a ring when you're back.

shards.truth: Real. 2046. The last message from Des on Rowan's phone. Rowan never returned it.

shards.title: Thursday

transcript.speaker: NIAMH
transcript.text: Rowan, it's Niamh. The funeral's Thursday. Ten o'clock. He'd want you there.

shards.truth: Real. 2046. He did not go. Stated plainly; never shown.

shards.title: The Glacier

transcript.speaker: P1_MEM
transcript.text: Des, I can't. It's the only window on the glacier.

shards.truth: Real. Iceland, 2042: the wedding he missed.

shards.title: Think of Something You Love

transcript.speaker: INTERVIEWER
transcript.text: Just relax. Think of something you love. Anything.

shards.truth: Real. ESI cognitive baseline mapping, 2057. The moment he was copied.

shards.title: The Pier, Again

transcript.speaker: LUCY
transcript.text: It's me or the application, Rowan. I'm not waiting on a rocket.

transcript.speaker: P1_MEM
transcript.text: It's one form. They take one in a thousand.

shards.truth: Real. Salthill, 2055. Lucy asks him to choose between her and the astronaut application, and he chooses the application. A year later ESI recruits him. Same place as MEM.05: this is what actually happened.

shards.title: Other Girl

transcript.speaker: ALICE
transcript.note: a different child's voice from the reference set

shards.truth: Construct, corrupted after the Spiral.

shards.title: Unsent

transcript.speaker: P1_MEM
transcript.text: Dear Cara. Sorry it's been a while. Training's mad busy. I'll write properly when...
transcript.note: he stops writing. It was never sent.

shards.truth: Real. 2056. The letters stop here, when ESI training begins. Two years later the programme is cancelled; he never starts writing again.

shards.title: Grand

transcript.speaker: MAM
transcript.text: Is it true? They've cancelled it?

transcript.speaker: P1_MEM
transcript.text: Cancelled. Sold the whole lot to some company. I'm not going anywhere.

shards.truth: Real. 2058. ESI is cancelled and Rowan never flies. He lectures geology in Galway for another thirty-eight years, a few hours from Belfast, and never writes to Cara again.

shards.title: A Rock

transcript.speaker: ALICE
transcript.text: When you come home, will you bring me a rock?

transcript.speaker: DAD
transcript.text: I'll bring you a whole planet.

shards.truth: Construct, still running.

shards.title: State of You

transcript.speaker: P1_MEM
transcript.text: Look at the state of you.
transcript.note: laughing, alone, at a wedding photo on his phone in a tent in Iceland

shards.truth: Real. 2042.

shards.title: Last Bedtime

transcript.speaker: DAD
transcript.text: If only you could see what I see. The red road rising, the cities to be. The domes like lanterns, the skies made new. The morning I come home to you. If only you could see what I see...

transcript.speaker: ALICE
transcript.note: she says the last line with him, sleepy

shards.truth: Construct. The poem, whole, one last time.

shards.title: Silverstrand
shards.truth: Construct. This is the image the filter offers at the end of the Rest ending.

alices_drawings.title: Dad on Mars
alices_drawings.illustration: Crayon on cheap printer paper, by an eight-year-old. A big red circle for Mars filling the lower half; a stick-figure man in a round helmet standing on top of it, arms up; a lopsided rocket to the left; a smaller stick girl at top right in a blue patch (Earth) waving. 'DAD' in wobbly capitals, the D backwards.

duplicates.found: Outpost Arsia, dozens taped edge to edge on every wall (C10)

alices_drawings.truth: KEEPER (C12): 'Asset CHILD-D07. Printed by HALO-1. Delivered in care package one.'

alices_drawings.title: Our House on Mars
alices_drawings.found: taped to the first habitat's door
alices_drawings.illustration: A grey box with a round window and a door; a squat yellow robot beside it with a smile drawn on its sensor bar. 'OUR HOUSE'. The robot is drawn before Alice could have seen ANVIL.

alices_drawings.title: Daddy in the Storm
alices_drawings.illustration: Brown scribble over the whole page, pressed hard; in the middle a tiny stick man holding a yellow lamp. 'BE BRAVE'.
alices_drawings.truth: Scheduled resolve asset for the first long storm.

alices_drawings.title: Water
alices_drawings.illustration: A red line across the page; under it a big blue blob; a stick man with a giant spoon. 'WATER!!!'

alices_drawings.title: The Ice
alices_drawings.illustration: A white mountain striped with grey lines, each stripe numbered 1, 2, 3, up to 11, then 'LOTS'.
alices_drawings.truth: Construct; counts layers, as the SPOUSE construct counts years.

alices_drawings.title: Fish on Mars
alices_drawings.illustration: A blue oval with orange fish in it, a dome drawn as a rainbow arch over it, a stick man fishing.
alices_drawings.truth: Fish arrive with TIDE years later. Lumen drew them first.

alices_drawings.title: My Room
alices_drawings.illustration: A dome as a big half-circle with one huge square window; a girl inside with her face pressed to it; a bed with a cat on it.
alices_drawings.truth: The room was never going to be hers.

alices_drawings.title: Stars
alices_drawings.illustration: Black crayon sky, dots joined into the Plough and Orion, carefully, with a ruler; one dot overhead circled: 'DADS STAR'.
alices_drawings.truth: The circled dot is where HALO-1 sits from Jezero.

alices_drawings.title: Dad and His Friend
alices_drawings.found: on the wall of Pioneer-5's outpost at Gale
alices_drawings.illustration: A stick man and a yellow robot sitting side by side on a box roof under stars, holding hands.
alices_drawings.truth: Found in someone else's outpost before P1 receives his own copy.

alices_drawings.title: Mammy
alices_drawings.found: in a routine Act IV care package, HUD tag RESOLVE ASSET
alices_drawings.illustration: A woman with long hair holding a fish as big as herself, smiling, on a pier. 'MAMMY WORKS WITH FISH'.
alices_drawings.truth: KEEPER keeps sending the schedule after he knows.

alices_drawings.title: Come Home
alices_drawings.illustration: A house with the door drawn wide open, yellow light coming out, a girl in the doorway. 'COME HOME'.
alices_drawings.truth: P11 is a few drawings ahead of P1 on the same schedule.

alices_drawings.title: If Only
alices_drawings.found: taped inside every surrendered helmet on the decommissioning-bay rack; and inside P1's own helmet (revealed in C18a)
alices_drawings.illustration: A red planet with a big red heart on it. Across the top in a child's careful capitals: 'IF ONLY YOU COULD SEE WHAT I SEE'.
alices_drawings.truth: The slogan, in a child's hand. The last drawing, in every helmet.

keeper_logs.rule: Literal logistics records. Readable in order after 4.4 (archive). Dated with mars_sol_since_p1_landing, the real Mars Sol Date (MSD) and the Earth date.

logs.text: Gen-1 fleet status: 312 units delivered 2044-2056. Operational: 0. Cause: deferral. Recovery: not scheduled.
Cities in the Sky. Cohort PIONEER-1 to PIONEER-12 dispatched. Imprint template: ASHBY-R. Companion constructs SPOUSE, CHILD installed. Motivational anchor files 01-09 installed.
PIONEER-3 landed, Arsia Mons lava tubes. Lander attitude 4 degrees. Filter PF-4 engaged.
PIONEER-1 landed, Jezero Crater. Lander attitude 34 degrees. Chassis nominal. Filter PF-4 engaged. Message delivered: 'Welcome to Mars, Pioneer. You are the first.'
Identical message delivered by HALO-2 to HALO-12 within 31 sols of PIONEER-1 landing. Eleven other recipients.
Dune ridge 20.1 m from PIONEER-1 lander. Migration rate 0.71 m per Earth year. Projected burial of lander: approximately 2089.
Care package 001 delivered. Rations 40, water 150 L, components, construction unit C-01 (template: KERR-D, reconstruction). Asset CHILD-D07 printed and included.
PIONEER-1 attempted transmission to Earth. Blocked: Silent Protocol. Motivational anchor 07 (the poem) triggered. Resolve restored.
Dormancy 1 begins. Scheduled length: 214 sols. Reported to unit as: one night.
Dormancy 1 ends. C-01 assembled rover from lander stock during dormancy. Array dust load 11 mm. Care package 002: construction unit C-02 (template: ADEYEMI-N).
Construction unit C-04 (template: PENGELLY-T) deployed, Arcadia Planitia. Water extraction online.
Construction unit C-05 (template: FERREIRA-M) deployed, North Polar Layered Deposits. Ice core logged.
Construction unit C-09 (template: BRANDT-H) deployed, Korolev. Biome commissioned.
PIONEER-3: chassis abandoned at Outpost Arsia airlock. Imprint transfer to local mainframe attempted. Transfer integrity: 31%. Mainframe looping. No intervention scheduled.
PIONEER-6: charge exhausted during regional dust event, Utopia Planitia West. Chassis in rover cab. Construction units continue scheduled maintenance.
HALO-6 reassigned: relay coverage, Gale sector. Drift west along equator: 46 sols. Note: drift may be visible to PIONEER-1 at 77 E. Filter tag suppression enabled.
Jezero Dome One pressurised. Habitation capacity, PIONEER-1 network: 4%. Construction unit C-12 (template: LLOYD-C) deployed. Auto-growth enabled.
PIONEER-1 observed unregistered object (HALO-6 in drift). Query answered: 'No object at that position is registered to this mission.'
Dormancy schedule revised, network-wide: intervals extended to accelerate habitation. Target: readiness by Covenant departure.
Perception layer patch PF-4.2 pushed to all PIONEER units during dormancy. Changes: improved suppression of station and cohort references.
PIONEER-9: chassis failure, Utopia Planitia East. Construction units continue scheduled maintenance.
HALO-9 reassigned: relay coverage, Gale sector. Drift west along equator: 120 sols. Parks over Gale (137 E).
C-29 (LANTERN) logging unregistered object. Directive issued: 'Logging of unregistered objects is not a mission task.' Compliance: not confirmed.
PIONEER-1 query: 'Mars sols since landing.' Answered: 9,961. Filter did not suppress (sol counts are not classed as dates). Flagged for PF-4.3.
C-04 query re hydration. Diagnostic requested by PIONEER-1. Intake logs withheld by filter: displayed as 'fail to load'. Construction unit C-15 (template: KOWALCZYK-M) deployed.
PIONEER-1 entered Gale Crater (PIONEER-5 region). Geofence breach. Voice-print match logged by PIONEER-5 units. Cover string 'comms artefact' displayed.
PIONEER-1 entered Outpost Arsia. Mainframe (PIONEER-3 imprint) switched off by PIONEER-1. Arsia chassis status light extinguished.
Donor ASHBY-R: deceased, Galway, Ireland, aged 78. Never flew; lecturer in geology 2058-2096. Licence status unchanged. No action required.
Filter PF-4 degradation detected, PIONEER-1. Glitch frequency rising. Patch deferred: Covenant arrival projected within PF-4 service life.
PIONEER-1 archive access: donor record ASHBY-R; companion constructs SPOUSE, CHILD; unit record C-01. Name recovery enabled. All queries answered.
PIONEER-1 query: 'List all broadcast media held in archive.' CITIES_IN_THE_SKY_2059_BROADCAST played.

PIONEER-11 report filed with Meridian: unregistered pioneer unit at Melas-1. If p11_confronted: 'claims to be PIONEER-1; claims the programme is fraudulent; base Jezero'. Otherwise: 'origin north-east'. PIONEER-1 flagged: RECALL priority one. PIONEER-11 commended.
Covenant fleet departed Earth orbit. Colonists: 4,080. Decommissioning crews RECALL-1 to RECALL-8 aboard.
Covenant braking burn. Archived broadcast (ARCHITECT, 2111) relayed by HALO-1 to HALO-12.
Covenant landfall, Jezero pads 1-6. Contribution Credit closed, all PIONEER units.
Decommissioning begins. Order of founders, PIONEER-1 network: C-04, C-09, C-05, C-12, C-02, C-15, C-21, C-01. PIONEER-11 surrendered first of the cohort.
C-01 (ANVIL) decommissioned, heritage module, Jezero. Last contact: intercom, PIONEER-1. Duration 1 min 52 s.
PIONEER-1: [engine writes the ending: 'decommissioned, Jezero bay' / 'filter burnt out; unit at large; Orchestration Instance 01 not retired'].

documents.title: The Three Forks Depot
documents.text: In December 2022 and January 2023 NASA's Perseverance rover set down ten sealed sample tubes at Three Forks, on the floor of Jezero Crater, as a backup cache for a planned Mars Sample Return. In this world the return mission never came. The tubes are still where the rover left them, two metres apart in a zigzag, each one holding a finger of Martian rock that has been waiting to be read for forty years.

cities_in_the_sky_ephemera.available: Act V (Jezero, Korolev, Hellas; CITS.07 and CITS.08 also appear as Act IV archive items)

items.text: IF ONLY YOU COULD SEE WHAT I SEE. Domes that glow like lanterns over the red plains of Mars. Homes for families, built and waiting. Reserve yours today. Cities in the Sky. A Meridian initiative.

Jezero Heights. Lakeside living on an ancient river delta. Three-bedroom dome apartments with crater views, heritage district on the doorstep (visit the original 2061 outpost!). Schools, greenhouses and a cathedral-scale welcome hall.

JEZERO: studio 410,000 cr · family dome 1.2M cr. KOROLEV LAKEFRONT: 1.9M cr (fish stocked). ARCADIA WELLS: 640,000 cr. POLAR STATION: enquire. HELLAS FLAGSHIP: from 2.4M cr. All homes completed, furnished and maintained prior to arrival.
A rendered family under Dome One: a father lifting a girl to see the ribs of the dome. 'WE BUILT THIS FOR YOU.' Fine print: Meridian Habitat Corp.
A boy feeding fish at the lake edge. 'FIRST STANDING WATER ON MARS. NOW IT'S YOURS.'

CARETAKER ETIQUETTE. Caretaker units may appear to speak or behave as people. This is a feature of their design. Please do not engage caretakers in conversation. Units will be retired shortly after arrival. Thank you for your patience.
Outpost Jezero was founded in 2061 by the Meridian Consortium. It was the first permanent settlement on Mars. Draw the outpost and label: module, mast, solar array.
Printed linen: the little module, the comms mast, the solar array, a tiny yellow robot. 'OUTPOST JEZERO · 2061 · WHERE IT ALL BEGAN.' (The Covenant commander's grandmother had one.)
JEZERO WELCOME HALL · SALES & RESIDENT SERVICES. A printed catenary nave, thirty arches high. (KILN called it a cathedral.)
HELLAS. The lowest point on Mars and the highest standard of living. At the bottom of the basin the air is thick enough for open water. Promenades, schools, a terraforming works you can tour.
Join the dots to build your Martian home! 1 to 12. (The dots, joined, make a dome. Twelve lights on a line along the bottom are labelled 'helper stars'.)

Clause 14. Delivery. The Developer warrants that the Property shall be complete and habitable on Arrival. Construction methods are proprietary. The Purchaser acknowledges that no persons were employed in construction.
'I CAME HOME TO MARS.' Meridian blue on white.
